title: Rainbow Hospitals
extract: Rainbow Children's Medicare, commonly known as Rainbow Hospitals, is an Indian chain of paediatric hospitals headquartered in Hyderabad. Founded by Dr. Ramesh Kancharla in 1999, the hospital's main focus is paediatric and maternal healthcare services. The flagship facility of Rainbow Children's Hospitals is located at Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The Rainbow Hospital Group currently operates out of 19 hospitals and 3 outpatient clinics – eight in Hyderabad, four in Bangalore, two each in Delhi, Chennai, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam.
